text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Eleven thousand pupils, from high density suburbs around the capital Harare and neighbouring Chitungwiza town have failed to start secondary education because of a shortage of school places.
- Angolan Foreign Minister Venancio de Moura met Zimbabwean President Robert Mugabe to deliver a special message from President Eduardo dos Santos on the peace process in Angola.
- South African police have intensified patrols along the border with Zimbabwe in an attempt to shut out thousands of Zimbabweans trying to cross illegally in search of jobs.
